The private decoder runs at module initialization over immutable vendored complete pairs. A scoped tokenizer mock supplies absent and singleton token lists to prove the restored missing-index guard without changing those tables or exporting a test-only API. This pure decoder has no Effect service to substitute with a Layer; normal-table tests independently verify every real pair.

Only vi is imported from vitest because its hoisted module-mock transform requires a direct vitest import; importing vi through @effect/vitest fails mock resolution. Tests and assertions use @effect/vitest and the test runs with it.effect.
